method: Whole-tree term census first, then per-module inspection of the modules the commission named. Counts are exact; zero is reported as zero.

tree_wide_term_census.note: searched the whole current tree at the startup SHA
tree_wide_term_census.VERDICT: The concept appears NOWHERE in current code and NOWHERE in any adopted Field Forge / OBL authority. Every tree-wide occurrence is a historical DDM artifact, an old checkpoint, a documentary index, or this commission.

modules_inspected.role: closest current analogue to source admission
modules_inspected.self_declared_scope_verbatim: The contract does not infer source authority. It validates a caller-supplied positive exact AuthoritySnapshot and materializes only at that authority's source-local ceiling.
modules_inspected.also_verbatim: Population, weighted-estimand, pooling, backfill and harmonization authority remain separately governed.
modules_inspected.reason: explicitly disclaims inferring source authority; validates rather than selects

modules_inspected.key_fact: EmpiricalQuerySpec.REQUIRED_FIELDS includes empirical_universe_refs; the spec raises 'EmpiricalQuerySpec requires exact source universe scope' when empty
modules_inspected.reason: the universe set is a CALLER-SUPPLIED REQUIRED FIELD, and there is no service/population/geography/effective-time driver field from which admissibility could be derived

modules_inspected.key_fact: implements the accepted P07 source-plurality law with typed relation kinds and an I07 composite guard
modules_inspected.reason: owns the RELATION power between admitted universes, not which universes are admissible

modules_inspected.role: maps an admitted empirical fact to one bounded structural interpretation
modules_inspected.reason: consumes an already-admitted fact; applicability is upstream of it

modules_inspected.role: the consumer for 'give the positioned-subject possibility distribution'

modules_inspected.key_fact_verbatim: Immutable exact-key authority registry; no latest/default lookup exists.
modules_inspected.reason: an exact-key lookup CANNOT answer 'which source applies to this (service, target, time, geography, population)?'. A per-service resolver needs precisely the derived/default lookup this registry refuses to perform.
